## Activity

Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 340 captures during November 2019. Activity was maintained across the month, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The available activity information indicates that the site continued to provide the expected imaging service during the reporting period. No other operational exception is noted in the information provided.

## Image quality

There were 18 ungradable captures. This represents an ungradable rate of 5.3 per cent. The result provides a clear measure of the proportion of images that could not be used for grading and should be considered alongside the total of 340 captures. The reported image-quality position is therefore based on the completed activity for November 2019.

## Grading

A total of 50 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 2 days. This records the central grading turnaround for the month and indicates the time between capture and completion of grading for the reported activity. The referable outcome and grading wait are presented with the site’s activity and image-quality measures to provide a concise operational summary for Harbour Eye Clinic.
